svg.title: Pause and resume on the next request
svg.desc: Run upstream; Reach interaction; Save resume state: Entries / edges / outputs; Show choice/form; Submit next request; Restore chat state; Consume input; Continue downstream. upstream → node; node → save; save → show; show → submit: Wait for user; submit → load; load → input; input → downstream
